NKOSINATHI TSHABALALA
Software Engineer | C# / .NET | AWS Serverless
Pretoria, South Africa

I build full-stack products, reusable backend platforms and event-driven systems. My work focuses on C#/.NET backend development and AWS serverless applications, supported by React and TypeScript frontends.

My projects include an ecommerce platform for Saelune Active, a business operations platform for South African freelancers and small businesses, and a reusable blog and CMS platform.

I use Clean Architecture, automated testing and infrastructure as code to keep systems understandable and repeatable.

This desktop is a small collection of that work. My Projects opens the live websites; Media Player contains their screenshot walkthroughs; this folder contains my CV and background.
